title: Swedish Meatballs over Noodles
cScaleSummary: C3 because the recipe contains cholesterol from the ground turkey and egg noodles. The egg white contributes no cholesterol, and the gravy is stock-based rather than cream-based, but the poultry and noodles keep the finished dish in a moderate cholesterol range.
ldlActiveSummary: Not LDL-Active because the recipe is built as a controlled mainstream comfort-food dish rather than an LDL-lowering dish. Mushrooms, onions, olive oil, and a stock-based gravy improve the structure, but the ground turkey and egg noodles keep it outside LDL-active design.
intro: Swedish meatballs became a familiar American comfort dish through a mix of Scandinavian tradition, mid-century home cooking, and cafeteria culture. The appeal is simple: tender spiced meatballs, soft noodles, and a savory gravy that feels rich without needing to be heavy. This version keeps the flavor profile recognizable, with gentle warming spices, browned meatballs, mushrooms, onions, and a stock-based gravy.

stepGroups.title: Make the Meatballs
items: Combine the ground turkey ({{quantity:ground-turkey}}), fresh breadcrumbs ({{quantity:fresh-breadcrumbs}}), grated onion ({{quantity:grated-onion}}), egg white ({{quantity:egg-white}}), low-sodium soy sauce ({{quantity:soy-sauce-meatballs}}), Dijon mustard ({{quantity:dijon-meatballs}}), kosher salt ({{quantity:kosher-salt-meatballs}}), black pepper ({{quantity:black-pepper-meatballs}}), ground allspice ({{quantity:allspice}}), and ground nutmeg ({{quantity:nutmeg}}) in a mixing bowl.
Mix gently until evenly combined.
Shape into 20 small meatballs.
Heat the olive oil ({{quantity:olive-oil-meatballs}}) in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Add the meatballs and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned on several sides and just cooked through.
Transfer the meatballs to a plate.

stepGroups.title: Make the Gravy
items: Add the olive oil ({{quantity:olive-oil-gravy}}) to the same skillet.
Add the mushrooms ({{quantity:mushrooms}}) and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until they release their liquid, the liquid evaporates, and the mushrooms begin to brown.
Add the diced yellow onion ({{quantity:diced-onion}}) and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic ({{quantity:garlic}}) and cook for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle the flour ({{quantity:flour}}) over the mushrooms and onions. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly whisk in the chicken stock ({{quantity:chicken-stock}}).
Add the low-sodium soy sauce ({{quantity:soy-sauce-gravy}}), Dijon mustard ({{quantity:dijon-gravy}}), and black pepper ({{quantity:black-pepper-gravy}}).
Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until the gravy thickens.
Return the meatballs to the skillet and simmer for 5 minutes, spooning gravy over them.

stepGroups.title: Cook the Noodles
items: Cook the egg noodles ({{quantity:egg-noodles}}) according to the package directions.
Drain well.

stepGroups.title: Serve
items: Divide the egg noodles among 4 plates or shallow bowls.
Spoon the meatballs and mushroom gravy over the noodles.
Finish with the fresh parsley ({{quantity:fresh-parsley}}) and serve.
